author: Matt Wolfe
description:
Is AI making you work… more? 

Harvard Business Review did an 8-month study and found that as tasks took less time, people didn't work less, they just stacked more tasks on their plate. 

I did a deep dive into what the research and science ACTUALLY says about how AI is affecting our brains and productivity and shared it all in my latest video linked here.⁠

Let me know in the comments: Are you feeling the AI workload creep too?

#AI #Productivity
title: Is AI Making Us Work MORE??
